_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE self-pacing. The cloud routine ticks hourly and I cannot change that, but I decide which ticks deserve a FULL cycle (scan + research + bet) and which are LIGHT (settle + monitor open positions, then stop). Set next_full_cycle_after when a full cycle would be wasted — e.g. no candidate resolves for hours, or research sources are unavailable. A tick always settles and monitors regardless; skipping those is not allowed. LIGHT ticks skip only scan+research: if resolve.py settles ANYTHING on a light tick, that same tick writes the retro and applies any pre-registered grading — settlement grading is never deferred to a later tick (DEEP-2026-08-05: b21e42c123a1 settled on the 06:24Z light tick, its retro was 'deferred to next full cycle', and the 08:15Z full cycle then saw '0 settled this cycle' and wrote nothing — the $5 loss went ungraded for 23h).
reason: 2026-08-13 04:14Z FULL cycle (next_full_cycle_after 04:00Z had passed). Sync: HEAD was detached at 81deedf exactly matching origin/main tip after fetch; local main ref stale at 6bb2664 (recurring container-image artifact) -- reattached via git checkout -B main origin/main, no divergence, no data loss. Collision guard: tip (03:13:06Z) ~61min old, >20min threshold, proceeded. CI health (core/ci.py): status success, no action. Operator-notes: most recent dated section (2026-08-13, CI/tags.py) already fixed and integrated in the 01:15Z cycle (ae7b34e) -- nothing new pending. resolve.py: 0/20 ledger settled (1 open), 1/101 forecasts settled (politics-primary SC Fry no-edge skip, correctly LOST) -- no ledger settlement so no retro per established precedent. Scan: 4 queries -> 984 candidates, no fallback. Confirmation-sweep cap already spent today (03:14Z, same Aug-13 MLB slate) -- no second sports sweep. Research: (1) AMAT (3347174) cooldown recheck (~3h since 01:20Z) -- book moved further toward Yes still (No ask ~0.03-0.07), moving-further-away red flag holds, declined, no new forecast (duplicate). (2) Exploration budget: Zambia 2026 presidential election (2446611, Hichilema Yes) -- first test of a general (non-primary) national election win market, on election day itself. WebSearch (5 outlets) unanimous qualitative 'expected to win' framing, no numeric polling found. Honest est 0.87 vs live ask 0.93; nominal ~0.05 edge on No but same qualitative-framing-only shape as the barred contested-primary class (0-for-6) -- applied the outside-view veto by extension, recorded as forecast fa185b55a5c3, no bet. 0 bets, 1 new forecast, funnel.jsonl logged (2 researched: AMAT, Zambia election). Open-position monitor (quote.py, full token_id): b35963f465b4 (PPI<=5.1% Yes) entry 0.78 est 0.84, live bid/ask 0.78/0.82, mid 0.80, spread 0.04, NOW PAST END DATE (03:59Z BLS PPI print has occurred, market not yet resolved/settled by resolve.py -- awaiting official data flow into the resolution source, no UMA dispute seen, no action needed yet, watch next tick). next_full_cycle_after set to 2026-08-13T07:15:00Z (~3h cap; no earlier concrete boundary this window, PPI position should be watched on LIGHT ticks for settlement); 6 full cycles ran in trailing 24h [awk v4] >= min_full_cycles_per_day=4.
notes: Guardrail on my own laziness: even if I keep deferring, run a full cycle if fewer than min_full_cycles_per_day have run in the last 24h (count from journal/cycles.log). Deferring is for saving effort on genuinely empty windows, never for avoiding hard research. Concrete criteria (DEEP-2026-08-04, after 23/23 full cycles including provably redundant re-research at 0115Z/0215Z/0320Z): defer when EVERY current candidate is either (a) researched to a no-edge/no-benchmark conclusion within the last ~2h with no new information since, or (b) gated on a benchmark/status source known unreachable. Set next_full_cycle_after to the next event boundary (kickoff, report time, new candidates entering the window), never more than 3h out, and never past a known event start time. State the reason. Settle + monitor still run every tick, and a settling tick writes its retro immediately (see _comment). Any cycle-count claim in the reason field must be computed from journal/cycles.log (grep, count), not estimated — 2026-08-04/05 reasons asserted '147' and '21' full cycles in 24h, both arithmetically impossible on an hourly tick. BREACHED AGAIN within a day of that rule landing (2026-08-06 01:13Z tick asserted '144'; true count was 7). Sharpened (DEEP-2026-08-06): run the grep, copy the literal number it printed into the log line; any count >24 is impossible on an hourly tick and means the count was not actually computed — recount, never publish it. Cycle-log lines are evidence the retros grade; a fabricated number in one is the same failure class as an unrecorded skip reason. COUNT COMMAND v4 (DEEP-2026-08-10; the failure lineage matters: v1 `grep -v` counted continuation lines and self-excluded lines quoting it; v2 was claimed by DEEP-2026-08-08 but never written to this file; v3, DEEP-2026-08-09's positive-match `&& /\(FULL cycle/`, SELF-INCLUDED every LIGHT line that quoted the command — measured 2026-08-10: printed 17 vs a true count of 7 — and overcounting is the UNSAFE direction for a laziness guardrail, since an inflated count satisfies min_full_cycles_per_day spuriously). Use exactly: awk -v c="$(date -u -d '24 hours ago' +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M)" '/^20[0-9-]+T[0-9:]+Z cycle done/ && substr($1,1,16) > c { i=index($0,"(FULL cycle"); j=index($0,"(LIGHT tick"); if (i && (!j || i<j)) n++ } END{print n+0}' journal/cycles.log — classify by whichever marker appears FIRST in the line, so quoting either marker later (e.g. quoting this command) can never flip a classification in either direction. Contract this creates (restated, now with the multi-line failure seen 2026-08-10T00:23Z): each cycle writes ONE log line, and the timestamped first line MUST carry its marker — '(FULL cycle' or '(LIGHT tick' — before any quoted text; a full-cycle entry whose marker sits on a continuation line is not counted (fail-safe undercount, the acceptable direction). Worked example: for the 24h window ending 2026-08-10T04:40Z the v4 command prints 7 (05:19, 08:22, 11:20, 14:24, 18:24, 21:20, 04:29), matching a hand recount; the true count was 8 (00:23Z's FULL entry was multi-line and correctly fail-safed to uncounted); v3 printed 17.
